counting_policy: The V1 budget is consumed and carried forward unchanged; FAM-BREAKOUT stays exhausted at 4/4 configurations and 15/15 trials. This V2 allocation adds exactly two configurations and eight profile evaluations under one new root. Cost profiles and the timing perturbation are trials, not mechanisms. Numeric-only variants have a zero allowance. Extensions require a new explicit Research Director decision and immutable allocation record.
